launches.title: OpenWork - The open source alternative to Claude Cowork
launches.tagline: An enterprise-ready alternative to Claude Cowork
launches.body:
Hi! This is Ben from OpenWork.

We're building an **open source, enterprise-ready alternative to Claude Cowork** that companies can deploy internally — with **their own LLMs, their own infrastructure, and their own compliance posture**.

We launched 3 months ago, and already have 14k GitHub stars and 150k+ downloads.

OpenWork is:

\- **Desktop** that you can provide to your non-technical employees.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100181&key=user_uploads/571092/b4e8acf0-097b-4320-88f2-aca59afd8b42)

\- **Cloud** that lets you administer which skills, plugins, mcps your users have access to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100181&key=user_uploads/571092/ed1de3e2-31bf-4a27-b1b8-7326cf2aef92)

Some advantages over Claude Cowork:

\- **Deploy it where you want.** Use our cloud, or self-host on-premise, in your cloud, or hybrid. Companies with stricter requirements keep everything inside their trust perimeter.

\- **Model-independent, cost-controlled.** Bring your own: self-hosted, Bedrock, Azure, Vertex, or any of 50+ providers. Route per task so you only pay frontier prices when it actually matters.  

\- **Reuses what you have.** Internal MCPs, runbooks, scripts, and docs become agent capabilitie    

\- **Shared across the team.** Technical and non-technical teammates use the same agents from the UI, Slack, or Telegram.

Open source. No lock-in on infra or models.

Ways to get started:

1\. Try the desktop app - no sign-in required

2\. Sign in to our cloud

or:

book a demo:

<https://cal.com/team/openwork/enterprise>
